history.title: Your effort, recorded.
history.empty: Your completed sessions will appear here.

log.title: Log a session
log.empty: Choose a tracker to log a session.

progress.title: The bigger picture.
progress.empty: Log two sessions to see your first trend.

profile.title: Your space, your rules.
profile.caption: Profile & settings
profile.syncNote: Changes sync across your devices. Your data is converted, never reset.
profile.unsynced: Saved on this device. It will sync when you’re back online.
profile.personalBody: Your sessions stay private. Export your data whenever you want, in a format that belongs to you.

delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.body: This permanently deletes your trackers, sessions, goals and records, and signs you out on every device.

password.title: Change password
password.body: Other devices will be signed out. This one stays signed in.
password.sameAsCurrent: Choose a password different from the current one.
password.doneBody: This device stays signed in; other devices were signed out.

export.title: Export your data
export.body: Open formats that belong to you. JSON keeps everything; CSV opens in Excel, Numbers or Google Sheets.
export.everythingHint: JSON · trackers, sessions, goals and books
export.csvHint: CSV · one row per session or set
export.empty: No trackers yet. Add one, and it can be exported here.

links.trackersHint: What you track and how it looks

notFound.title: Off the beaten path.
notFound.body: This page doesn’t exist. Your progress is right where you left it.

hero.title: The quiet power of showing up.
hero.body: A space for your strength, your miles, your books. And everything you’re becoming.

welcome.caption: Your pace. Your progress.
welcome.title: Small efforts. Lasting change.
welcome.subtitle: A little stronger. A little further. Make room for what moves you.

signUp.title: Keep your progress.
signUp.subtitle: One account. Every session, safely in sync.

logIn.title: Pick up where you left off.
logIn.subtitle: Your next small win is waiting.
logIn.expiredBody: Log in again to keep going.

forgot.title: Let’s get you back in.
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we’ll send a secure reset link.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, we sent a link. It expires in 30 minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password.
reset.subtitle: You’ll be signed out on every device.
reset.doneBody: Log in with your new password.
reset.invalidBody: Reset links work once and expire after 30 minutes.

errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.passwordTooCommon: This password is too common. Try a longer or less predictable one.

errors.network: Can’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.timeout: The server took too long to answer. Try again.

choose.title: What do you want to track?
choose.subtitle: Choose your focus. You can always add more later.
choose.none: Choose at least one to continue.

goal.title: Find your weekly rhythm.
goal.subtitle: Set a goal that fits your life. Rest days are part of the plan.
goal.streakBody: Meet your goal each week to build your streak. No daily pressure.

ready.title: Your next chapter starts here.
ready.subtitle: Your trackers are ready. Your first week is a fresh start.

trackers.label: Trackers
trackers.title: Make it your own.
trackers.caption: Your trackers
trackers.empty: No active trackers. Create one to start logging.

typeBodies.general: A duration or a simple counter

space.eyebrow: A space for every kind of progress
space.body: Track your sessions without turning your life into a checklist.

fields.name: Tracker name
fields.nameHint: A short, personal name works best.
fields.sessionsNote: Everything you log becomes a session inside this tracker.
fields.modeHint: Time adds up minutes; a number counts things like glasses of water. This can’t be changed later.
fields.modeFixed: Chosen when the tracker was created.
fields.unitHint: What one step is called, e.g. glasses.

detail.mainBody: Home shows the main tracker’s weekly goal and streak.
detail.archiveBody: Archived trackers leave your lists but keep their sessions in your history.
detail.restoreBody: Restore it to log sessions and follow its goals again.
detail.archivedNotice: This tracker is archived. Its sessions stay in your history.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: Its sessions ({{sessions}}) and goals are deleted too and leave your history, stats and exports. To keep them, archive the tracker instead.

goals.label: Goals
goals.title: A rhythm that fits.
goals.caption: Goals · small steps, clear direction
goals.empty: No goals yet. A weekly goal starts your streak.
goals.noTrackers: Create a tracker first, then give it a goal.

kindHints.amount: How much each day or week.
kindHints.cumulative: A total to reach by a date.

streak.bodyStart: Reach this week’s {{tracker}} goal to start a streak.
streak.fallbackBody: Weekly streaks count consecutive weeks where the goal is met. Rest days never reset your progress.
streak.note: Cumulative goals track a total by a date. They don’t count toward a weekly streak.
streak.body_one: Your {{tracker}} streak is {{count}} week. Reach this week’s goal to make it {{next}}.
streak.body_other: Your {{tracker}} streak is {{count}} weeks. Reach this week’s goal to make it {{next}}.
streak.bodyMet_one: You met this week’s goal. Your {{tracker}} streak is {{count}} week.
streak.bodyMet_other: You met this week’s goal. Your {{tracker}} streak is {{count}} weeks.

form.name: Goal name · optional

hints.week: Your weekly goal resets every Monday.
hints.day: Your daily goal starts fresh every day.
hints.cumulative: Counts everything from today until the end date.

changeHint.week: A new target counts from this week on; past weeks keep theirs.
changeHint.day: A new target counts from today on; past days keep theirs.
changeHint.cumulative: A new target or end date applies at once.

form.pinHint: The tracker list and Home show the pinned weekly goal.
form.pinned: Pinned: the tracker list and Home show this goal.

errors.target: Enter a number above zero, with at most two decimals.
errors.targetWhole: Enter a whole number above zero.
errors.endDate: Choose an end date from today on.
errors.exists: This tracker already has a goal like this.

delete.title: Delete this goal?
delete.body: Its progress history goes with it. Your sessions stay.
delete.bodyStreak: Its streak and progress history go with it. Your sessions stay.
